descriptions:
Studeo Ballpen Refillable Quick Dry Erasable Ink 

The Studeo Ballpen uses quick-dry erasable ink for cleaner and more convenient writing. Its refillable design helps reduce waste and allows long-term use. The comfortable grip and smooth ink flow make it suitable for school, office, and everyday writing tasks.

Studeo A5 Notebook 120 Pages Easy Tear Design  

The Studeo A5 Notebook contains 120 pages suitable for writing notes, assignments, and daily tasks. Its sturdy binding helps keep pages secure while still allowing easy page tearing when needed. The compact A5 size makes it convenient to carry for school, office, or personal use.
